scope: Availability of eight-band host photometry conditional on already-selected DES-Dovekie SNe; not discovery/classification efficiency or SNIa population completeness.
cohort: All selected DES events in the three named C3,E2,X3 fields, exact metadata CID joined to corrected SMP host photometry. Full catalogue numbers reported before finite-feature exclusion.
label: Unique <=1arcsec actual-host/deep-counterpart match, all four published mask/fit flags zero, star/galaxy class1 and hostDLR<4.
model: Logistic regression, source-training mean/SD feature scaling, ridge penalty0.5*sum(beta_nonintercept^2). No feature selection or penalty tuning.
validation: Leave one of C3,E2,X3 out; fit using other two fields, report held-out Brier, AUC, mean predicted probability and observed availability. Training selection is never calibrated to held-out labels.
transport_diagnostic: Descriptive inverse probability weights1/p for available subset using held-out p; report effective sample size and observed means, no correction of unobserved age distribution. Positivity failure and residual imbalance remain explicit.
uncertainty: No claimed unbiased transport estimator: three fields cannot identify common calibration/footprint selection, and missingness need not be conditional only on the three measured covariates.
composite_field_parsing: Metadata values such as C1+C3 include the named target field and are assigned to it. No metadata row overlaps two of C3,E2,X3. This parsing clarification includes all declared target-field events.
